capabilities: award achievements for creating notes and deleting notes
award achievements for creating internal links, tags, and callouts
award achievements for using headings and core features like the command palette and quick switcher
extras: README warns of known mobile issues where achievements unlock too quickly or cannot be unlocked at all.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to gamify note-taking or reward users for hitting usage milestones.

relations.evidence: Thank you to pjeby for monkey-around that I used to hook into events in Obsidian.
Thank you to marcusolsson for obsidian-svelte that I used for creating many of the UI elements.

summary: Gamification plugin that tracks note-taking actions and awards achievements for milestones like creating notes, links, tags, and callouts.
